results.rationale: Consistency: the salmon cut, orange-white marbling and orientation are retained through the permitted poster recomposition. Instruction: centered fish, lemons, salt, herbs and glowing turquoise ground are present, but the required title becomes garbled Frish and Qugultty rather than Fresh · Pure · Quality. Quality: attractive coherent food forms, but multiple large misspellings and nonsensical central text are distracting semantic defects.

Consistency: the diamond motif remains recognizable, but cushion proportions become tall and its fabric pattern is heavily smeared. Instruction: a dark modern room and top-left bold title are supplied, but the cushion texture is damaged and the title collides with it rather than forming a clean minimal layout. Quality: distorted diamond fabric, implausibly oversized cushion placement and overlapping title fragments produce multiple distracting errors.
